title: Phase 0.6: Implement context propagation patterns
description: Define context.Context usage patterns, create context value helpers, document timeout strategies, and establish cancellation patterns. Context must be used consistently from day 1.
design:
Create internal/context/context.go:

**Context keys:**
```go
type contextKey string

const (
    requestIDKey  contextKey = "request_id"
    serviceKey    contextKey = "service"
    hostnameKey   contextKey = "hostname"
)
```

**Context creation:**
```go
// NewRequestContext creates context with standard timeout
func NewRequestContext() (context.Context, context.CancelFunc) {
    return context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
}
```

**Context value helpers:**
```go
func WithRequestID(ctx context.Context, id string) context.Context
func RequestID(ctx context.Context) string

func WithService(ctx context.Context, service string) context.Context
func Service(ctx context.Context) string

func WithHostname(ctx context.Context, hostname string) context.Context
func Hostname(ctx context.Context) string
```

Document patterns in internal/context/README.md:
- Every public function accepts ctx as first parameter
- Every HTTP handler creates context from request: ctx := r.Context()
- Every outbound call passes context
- Every goroutine respects context cancellation
- Timeout patterns (use context.WithTimeout)
- Cancellation patterns (defer cancel())

Write tests for:
- Value storage and retrieval
- Context propagation through call stack
- Timeout behavior
- Cancellation behavior
acceptance_criteria:
- Context helpers compile and work
- Request ID helper stores and retrieves correctly
- Service helper stores and retrieves correctly
- Hostname helper stores and retrieves correctly
- NewRequestContext creates context with 60s timeout
- Context cancellation works correctly
- Pattern documentation is clear
- Test coverage >= 85%

title: Phase 5: Service Engine - Configuration and Policy
description: Implement service configuration structures, service registry, and policy enforcement for path/method allowlists and request size limits.
design:
- Define Service and Policy configuration structures
- Implement service registry (map keyed by host_pattern)
- Implement service lookup by hostname (exact match)
- Implement path allowlist checking (glob matching)
- Implement method allowlist checking
- Implement request body size limit enforcement
- Integrate with MITM handler, secret providers, and auth strategies
acceptance_criteria:
- Service config structure defined
- Service registry loads services
- Service lookup returns correct service by hostname
- Path allowlist blocks disallowed paths (403)
- Method allowlist blocks disallowed methods (403)
- Body size limit enforced
- Integration test verifies policy enforcement

title: Write integration test for MITM with trusted CA

design:

- Start chaperone with MITM enabled

- Verify request reaches upstream

title: Verify SecretProvider interface and add provider registry
description: Verify the SecretProvider interface from Phase 0.1 meets implementation needs. Add credential_ref parser and provider registry infrastructure.
design:
NOTE: The SecretProvider interface is ALREADY DEFINED in Phase 0.1 (CHAP-dhf). This task adds the supporting infrastructure.

In internal/secrets/:
- Review provider.go interface from Phase 0.1
- Implement credential_ref parser (splits protocol:path)
  - Example: env:OPENAI_API_KEY -> protocol="env", path="OPENAI_API_KEY"
  - Example: file:/path/to/secret.txt -> protocol="file", path="/path/to/secret.txt"
- Create provider registry (map[string]SecretProvider)
- Add Register(name string, provider SecretProvider) function
- Add Get(protocol string) (SecretProvider, error) function
- Add Fetch(ctx context.Context, ref string) (string, error) convenience function that:
  1. Parses credential_ref
  2. Gets provider from registry
  3. Calls provider.Fetch()

Error types (ErrSecretNotFound, ErrPermissionDenied, ErrTimeout) are defined in Phase 0.2.

Write tests:
- credential_ref parser tests (various formats)
- Provider registration tests
- Provider retrieval tests
- Full Fetch() flow tests
acceptance_criteria:
- credential_ref parser splits correctly
- Parser handles edge cases (missing colon, multiple colons, etc.)
- Provider registry stores and retrieves providers
- Fetch() convenience function works end-to-end
- Test coverage >= 85%
- go test -race passes

title: Implement secret caching with TTL
description: Implement secret caching layer with 5-minute TTL to reduce provider calls while allowing rotation.
design:
In internal/secrets/:
- Create cache.go with CachedProvider wrapper
- Use sync.Map for concurrent access
- Store tuple: (secret string, expireAt time.Time)
- On Fetch(): check cache first, return if not expired
- If expired or missing: call underlying provider, cache result
- Set TTL to 5 minutes (configurable)
- Wrap all providers with caching automatically
- Add cache invalidation function
- Add cache stats (hits, misses)
acceptance_criteria:
- Cache returns cached value within TTL
- Cache calls provider after TTL expires
- Cache works correctly under concurrent load
- Cache invalidation works
- Unit tests verify TTL behavior
- No race conditions (go test -race passes)

title: Implement dynamic leaf certificate generation
description: Generate per-domain TLS certificates on-demand, signed by local CA, with appropriate Subject Alternative Names.
design:
In internal/mitm/:
- Create cert.go with certificate generation
- Generate RSA 2048-bit key per domain
- Create certificate signed by CA
- Set Subject CN to hostname
- Add SAN (Subject Alternative Name) for hostname
- Set 90-day validity period
- Implement certificate caching (sync.Map)
- Cache key: hostname string
- Handle wildcard domains (*.example.com)
- Add certificate serial number tracking
acceptance_criteria:
- Certificate generated for given hostname
- Certificate signed by CA (verifiable)
- SAN includes correct hostname
- Certificate cached correctly
- Subsequent requests use cached cert
- Unit tests for cert generation
- Wildcard certificates work (if needed)
